ValidationRule.description: Does not allow for DMS Type to be selected unless DMS is the Service Line
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(DMS_Type__c))), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'DMS'), ISPICKVAL( Second_Service_Line__c ,'DMS')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DMS Service Line cannot be selected unless NCSP Service Line is set to DMS.
